name: sam-monorepo
description: Monorepo root. The app is in frontend/, the CDK stacks in infra/, the API in backend/ (Python, managed by uv and not part of this workspace).
//engines: Kept equal to .nvmrc, which is the single source of truth and what CI reads via node-version-file. Node 20 reached end-of-life in April 2026; 24 is Active LTS and what this repo is developed on.
//next: NOT unused, and NOT an accidental duplicate of frontend's. Added so AWS Amplify would detect Next at the repo root. NOTE: the CDK stack deploys platform WEB (static export), not WEB_COMPUTE, so this may now be obsolete - see docs/plans/tooling-and-tests-plan.md Phase 3. Left in place deliberately: removing it is a separate one-line experiment that needs its own deploy to verify, not a change to bundle with the workspace move. The single lockfile makes this and frontend's pin resolve to one physical package; `npm run check:next-pin` keeps the two declarations equal.

scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w infra
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w frontend && npm run type-check -w infra
scripts.check: npm run check:next-pin && npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm test && npm run knip
